Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated “Richard N. Palmer” (the Connecticut Supreme Court justice) with a different person, “Richard Palmer (engineer),” and incorrectly treated the engineer’s British nationality as applicable to Richard N. Palmer. This disambiguation failure led to instructing use of the wrong Wikipedia page and an incorrect nationality assumption.
